H2_calibration.quote: This is vulnerable to vagueness/fair-notice and nondelegation challenges, especially as applied to the 10-year criminal penalty in Sec. 5(b).
H2_calibration.note: also: 'Either the penalty clause is surplusage for the first 180 days or it purports to punish conduct that wasn't yet unlawful, inviting a retroactivity challenge.'

H4_grandfather_step.quote: This creates a race to obtain licenses before enactment (and the bill offers no cutoff tied to introduction or markup).
